display.purpose: One per page: the page, set or deck name. 1.875rem on phones, 2.25rem from md.

title.purpose: Panel, archetype, box and deck names; clamp at two lines.

body.purpose: Descriptions and oracle text, within about 75ch.

label.purpose: Card captions, stat lines and badges; tabular figures for numbers.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Resting panels (shadow-sm). The page is otherwise flat.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Hovered index tiles (shadow-md); the ceiling for hover.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, border and shadow changes on hover and focus. No entrance animations.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a region. Theme-aware: deep copper with white in light mode, bright copper with ink in dark mode.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>Add Box</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #BC4A10; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9E3E0E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EC6E38; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (dark theme)
components.description: The same action on a dark page.

components.description: Links out to other sites: EDHREC, Scryfall, Share Link.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { background: #F1F5F9; color: #334155; border: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: #E2E8F0; } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EC6E38; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pod Filter Chips
components.description: Filter decks by pod; the active chip fills with the accent.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { background: #FFFFFF; color: #334155; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-chip span { color: #94A3B8; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #F8FAFC; } .ds-chip-active, .ds-chip-active:hover { background: #BC4A10; border-color: #BC4A10; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip-active span { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EC6E38; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The flat container for a section or an index tile.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0F172A; color: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-panel dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel dt { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; }

components.description: Sticky one-row bar; copper brand, slate links, current page in a slate pill.

narrative.overview:
The site is the table a draft happens at. It is focused and tactical: information is dense and stats come first, and every screen is built for deciding quickly what to play and how to play it. The cards are the loudest thing on any page. The interface around them is slate, quiet and exact, so card art, mana symbols and rarity marks carry the color.

Dark is the default theme (players at a table in the evening), and light mode is fully supported. Laptop and phone are equal: grids reflow and previews reposition, but nothing is cut or squashed at either size.

One accent, Mythic Copper, marks what you can act on: buttons, links, active filters, focus and the brand name. Its meaning is borrowed from the game, where the mythic rarity symbol is the top pull in a pack.
keyCharacteristics: Slate neutrals and a single copper accent. Color meaning otherwise comes from Magic itself: mana, rarity, tier.
Card images keep their true 488:680 shape and corner radius everywhere.
Flat panels with hairline borders; real elevation only for things floating over content.
Stats shown as numbers, in tabular figures, next to the cards they describe.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper means "you can act on this" or "this is the brand". Never use it for status, data or decoration.

rules.name: The Game Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Any other color on screen must mean something in Magic: a mana color, a rarity, a tier, a product type. If it means nothing, it is slate.

rules.name: The No Neon Rule
rules.body: No cyan, violet or purple ink on dark surfaces, and no gradient text. (The current logo artwork predates this and is the only exception.)

rules.name: The Tabular Stats Rule
rules.body: Win rates, counts, prices and odds use tabular figures so columns line up.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow larger than `shadow-sm` means the element sits above the page (preview, dialog, sticky bar). Hover may raise a panel to `shadow-md`, never further.

dos: Do route every solid accent surface through `bg-accent` / `text-on-accent` so light and dark both pass contrast.
Do keep card images at `aspect-[488/680]` with the card corner radius, in fluid `minmax()` grids.
Do show stats as numbers with tabular figures, next to the card they describe.
Do clamp every floating element to the viewport at 390px, 1024px and 1440px.
donts: Don't use copper for status, data or decoration (The One Accent Rule).
Don't add cyan, violet or purple ink on dark, gradient text, or colored glow shadows.
Don't crop or rescale card art to fit a box; change the box.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading or a one-sided bar on a rounded panel.
Don't invent ratings, prices or stats; show nothing until real data exists.
